theme: Mid-campaign VITRUVIUS re-score of adna.network at the Decade-1/Decade-2 boundary. Two independent fresh-context agent scorers (both claude-fable-5) on instrument v1.0 — deliberately unchanged from the baseline so the deltas mean something — against an evidence pack pinned at c9e8300. D3 (Onboarding/TTFS, weight 12) WITHHELD by operator ruling rather than re-scored provisionally a second time: its baseline 3 was explicitly conditional on a clean-machine TTFS run that still has not happened, and a second provisional number would wear the authority of a measurement it does not have. Composite therefore over 11 dimensions against a stated denominator of 88, with the baseline recomputed on the same 11 for a like-for-like delta.
series_note: THIS IS THE FIRST III RECORD OF THE ENTIRE HAUSSMANN CAMPAIGN, and the first of any campaign since cycle 165 on 2026-06-10 — a gap of roughly ten weeks. ADR-057 requires every measurement event to log here; Gate B (the 51.6 baseline), P1, and P2.1 through P2.5 all shipped without a cycle record. Stated plainly rather than quietly opening at 166. Note also that cycle 165's own `next` field reserved 166-168 for STR work ('c166-168 MAX-III deep per-page/section measure+iterate — C1 home-hero concrete-then-ethos'); that campaign closed 2026-07-01 (Track C terminal) and the reservation lapsed unspent. Cycle 166 is therefore a re-purposed number, not a continuation of 165's plan — a reader comparing the two would otherwise see an unexplained discontinuity.

instrument_drift.finding: Roughly 0.8 of D2's +1 is the instrument being read differently, not the site changing.
instrument_drift.detail: Both scorers awarded D2 anchor 4 ('search present and scoped') while both explicitly recorded that no site-wide search exists — they read the clause as satisfied by the registry's scoped search input. The baseline read the identical clause the opposite way, holding D2 at 3 for 'casing hard-404s + no site-wide search'. git log -S'Search by name' -- site/src dates that input to 5b9be4c, Storyweave P3 M3.1 — a PREVIOUS CAMPAIGN. The feature was present under both scorings. Half the baseline's stated blocker genuinely resolved (casing now 301s to canonical); half was only re-read.
instrument_drift.disposition: D2 stands at 4 — two independent reviewers reached it on the anchor's literal words and addressed the clause explicitly; overriding both would substitute the reconciler's reading for the instrument's. The +1 is annotated rather than banked as site improvement. Split estimated at ~+0.8 real / ~+0.8 drift, tagged [I], not measured.
instrument_drift.root_cause: Filed v1.1 anchor defect — conjunctive anchor bundles have no split rule, so a reviewer satisfying two of three clauses can award the rung. Same class caused the D5 divergence, where it was caught only because the reviewers disagreed.
instrument_drift.routed: v1.1 instrument fix to land before P5.2's full 12-dimension re-score, where the same defect would operate across twelve dimensions instead of one.
